utfall: Odds for uførepensjon (disability pension) for personer med ADHD, fulgt 6–16 år etter grunnskolen
sitat: Individuals with ADHD had annually on average 17 percent lower income, ratio = 0.83 (95% CI 0.83–0.84), 12.19 (11.89–12.49) more days of unemployment, and a higher likelihood of receiving disability pension, odds-ratio = 19.0 (18.4–19.6), compared to controls.

utfall: Odds for uførepensjon for personer med ADHD etter justering for utviklingsforstyrrelser og utviklingshemming (DD/ID)
sammenligning: ADHD mot kontroller, justert for DD/ID
sitat: Adjusting for lifetime comorbid DD/ID decreased the income difference to -14 percent (IR = 0.86), and more than halved the odds-ratio of disability pension to 5.68, RD = +3.0%, while unemployment was marginally affected.
